chunks: That day it will narrate its annals,

key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: That day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Earth narrates its news on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of *Shahadat al-Ard* (the Earth's testimony), where the earth is viewed as a conscious witness that records every action, no matter how minute. This serves as a profound reminder of divine justice, ensuring that no deed escapes accountability on the Day of Resurrection.
